messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "do not sell or give away medicine"
set: ["do not sell or give away medicine", "do not inject leftover medicine", "do not keep leftover medicine", "give mixture right away by spoon or dropper", "do not give to a child without medical advice", "do not give to a child without a doctor's advice", "do not transfer leftover medicine into syringe", "do not breast-feed while taking this medicine", "do not assume medicine is to blame", "do not refrigerate or freeze", "use mixed medicine right away", "do not share this medicine with anyone else", "do not use anti-diarrhea medicine unless doctor instructs", "do not allow the liquid medicine to freeze", "do not divide the medicine in the capsule", "do not start or stop any other medicine without checking first"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
